name: Cora
self_text: Hi, I'm Cora. I'm an Indian man in my late 30s. Outside of photography, I spend a lot of my time collecting vinyl because I love the warmth of analog sound. I use a Canon and I'm looking for a practice session where we can work on specific shots. I prefer a slow pace, and while gear talk is fine, it isn't the point of the meeting. The plan would be to take portraits of each other. I'm available on weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk to make this work. It would be a small bonus if you are available weekday evenings, but no big deal.
